A nested table flattened into a cell keeps its row boundaries as literal <br> when br_in_tables is enabled

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	htmd "github.com/xberg-io/html-to-markdown/packages/go/v3"
)

func main() {
	options := htmd.ConversionOptions{
		BrInTables:    true,
		CompactTables: true,
	}
	result, err := htmd.Convert(`<table><tr><td><p>Before</p><table><tr><th>ID</th><th>Status</th></tr><tr><td>123</td><td>Done</td></tr></table></td><td>Other</td></tr></table>`, &options)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Content)
}
```
